title: An explicit half-flip family of 32-modular Hadamard matrices at L = 3 mod 8: structural placement and mod-tower analysis
summary: Motivated by Eliahou's 64-modular Hadamard construction at the smallest open Hadamard order n=668, we introduce an explicit half-flip family of 32-modular Hadamard matrices at orders n=4L for L = 3 (mod 8). A master identity reduces the four-sequence Golay-quadruple condition under the half-flip ansatz (s, s*, sq, (sq)*) to a single-sequence type-restricted autocorrelation c_k^tau(s). The construction yields a closed-form expression for c_k^tau, a true Hadamard matrix at L=11, and 32-modular matrices at every L = 3 (mod 8), including the open orders n=716 and n=1132.
